snippet.title: Mayro's Heart Throbbing Adventure Wii ULTIMATE! (out now)
snippet.description:
Yep, after 2-3 years, Mayro's biggest adventure on the Wii (yet) is FINALLY HERE!
A new power-up
New enemies/enemy variants
New levels
New music
NEW EVERYTHING!

So what are everysingle one of y'all lazybones doin with your lives? Play it... NOW! Haha, ok but no pressure.

https://www.mediafire.com/file/05bak61ll11be4o/Mayro's+Heart+Throbbing+Adventure+Wii+Ultimate+version+1.1.zip/file

Direct where the final trailer was first shown: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fhjTXwBap6Q&t=8s

Also expect an update from me in the next day or two.
